verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee documents its own AI extraction parameters: `ai_query` takes a natural-language description of the information wanted, and `ai_extract_rules` provides semantic extraction. The docs explicitly position AI extraction as the alternative to CSS/XPath `extract_rules` when fields are semantic or the page structure is irregular, so no pre-written selectors are needed. Missing for 10: documentation of the structured output format or schema for `ai_extract_rules`, evidence that the LLM can choose fields on its own rather than from user-named ones, and independent or hands-on corroboration of extraction quality.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an LLM read a page and decide what structured fields to pull out without pre-written selectors

citations.quote: ai_query [string] ("") The information you want to extract from the webpage using AI
Use `extract_rules` for CSS/XPath-based extraction and `ai_query` or `ai_extract_rules` for semantic extraction.
Choose AI extraction when the desired field is semantic or the structure is irregular.
